claim_es: Excess supplemental vitamin B6 can cause peripheral neuropathy; ULs differ across US and EFSA assessments.
applicability: Nutritional adequacy and neurotoxicity risk; not a generic wellness supplement
mandatory_precautions: Assess neuropathy symptoms and cumulative B6 from multiple products
US adult UL 100 mg/day and EFSA adult UL 12 mg/day reflect different risk assessments; do not automatically apply either as target
Pregnancy and age require separate review
proposed_rule_decision: Do not authorize dose without verified jurisdictional upper limits and total intake
notes: Source-linked critical appraisal intake; individual primary papers and jurisdictional guidelines require further verification.
